+"""Camera-guided, incremental controller for this basketball episode.
+
+Usage: python /app/output/gen.py move X Y Z GRIP LABEL
+       python /app/output/gen.py hold GRIP STEPS LABEL
+       python /app/output/gen.py observe LABEL
+
+Coordinates are world-frame TCP goals in metres.  This controller uses only
+camera frames, depth, proprioception, and the public task target.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+
+
+def xyz_and_offset(result):
+    vals = dict(zip(result.meta["proprio"]["layout"], result.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    tcp = np.array([vals[f"tcp_{axis}"] for axis in "xyz"], dtype=float)
+    mocap = np.array([vals[f"mocap_{axis}"] for axis in "xyz"], dtype=float)
+    return tcp, mocap - tcp
+
+
+def save_result(result, label):
+    d = ROOT / label
+    result.save(d)
+    tcp, off = xyz_and_offset(result)
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "tcp": tcp.tolist(),
+                      "mocap_minus_tcp": off.tolist(),
+                      "opening": result.meta["proprio"]["now"][3],
+                      "control_steps": result.meta["control_steps"],
+                      "time_left_s": result.meta["time_left_s"]}, indent=2))
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+    move = sub.add_parser("move")
+    for name in ("x", "y", "z", "grip"):
+        move.add_argument(name, type=float)
+    move.add_argument("label")
+    hold = sub.add_parser("hold")
+    hold.add_argument("grip", type=float)
+    hold.add_argument("steps", type=int)
+    hold.add_argument("label")
+    observe = sub.add_parser("observe")
+    observe.add_argument("label")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    cams = list(robot.spec()["cameras"])
+    if args.command == "observe":
+        result = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+    elif args.command == "hold":
+        action = np.tile([0., 0., 0., args.grip], (args.steps, 1))
+        result = robot.submit("ee_delta", action, dt=robot.spec()["control_dt"],
+                              cameras=cams, video="frames", include_depth=True)
+    else:
+        start = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams[:1], video="frames")
+        tcp, offset = xyz_and_offset(start)
+        mocap = tcp + offset
+        goal_tcp = np.array([args.x, args.y, args.z], dtype=float)
+        goal_mocap = goal_tcp + offset
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(goal_mocap - mocap)) / .009)))
+        step = (goal_mocap - mocap) / (n * .01)
+        action = np.tile(np.r_[step, args.grip], (n, 1))
+        # Let the arm catch up before measuring the next pose.
+        action = np.vstack([action, np.tile([0., 0., 0., args.grip], (16, 1))])
+        result = robot.submit("ee_delta", action, dt=robot.spec()["control_dt"],
+                              cameras=cams, video="frames", include_depth=True)
+    save_result(result, args.label)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));

  lbl,n=label(mask); comps=[]

  cv=np.stack([(xs+7-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*sel,(ys-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*sel,sel],axis=1);gl=cv*np.array([1,-1,-1]);world=gl@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3];allp.append(world)
  print(cam,'pixels',len(xs),'centroid',xs.mean(),ys.mean(),'median surface',np.median(world,axis=0))
 p=np.vstack(allp);init=np.r_[tcp if name!='initial' else [0.022,0.67,0.025],0.025]
 fit=least_squares(lambda q: np.linalg.norm(p-q[:3],axis=1)-q[3],init,loss='soft_l1',f_scale=.002)
 print('fit',fit.x,'rms',np.sqrt(np.mean(fit.fun**2)))
